title: Auto breaktrough Open Source
script:
local brek = {
	buffer.fromstring("\001\018\000BreakthroughServer\005\000begin\004\000main\000\000\000\000")
}
-- credit: fbloodieCrypt
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local plrStats = player:WaitForChild("PlrStats")
local currentQi = plrStats:WaitForChild("CurrentQi").Value
local qiNeeded = plrStats:WaitForChild("QiNeeded").Value

while true do
    if currentQi > qiNeeded then
        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("ByteNetReliable"):FireServer(unpack(brek))
        -- print("OK") -- activated this print if you want to see if this code woreg(worked) or not
    end
    wait(0.1)
end

comments.text: A script that breaks through for you that way you can afk grind.
